name: moli
tagline: A native Rust browser built specifically for AI agents
description: moli bills itself as the best browser for AI agents, a native Rust browser designed from the ground up for agent workloads rather than human tab-hoarding. It is an early but promising entrant in the fast-forming agent-browser race, aiming to give autonomous agents a fast, reliable surface to navigate the web. For anyone following where agents browse, this is a name to keep an eye on.
highlights: A native browser purpose-built for AI agents
Written in Rust for speed and reliability
An early, promising entry in the agent-browser race
Focused on agent workloads instead of human browsing habits
curatorNote: The agent-browser race is heating up, and moli is a fresh Rust-native take tailored to agents rather than humans. Young, but the direction feels right.
